integrity: Proof includes a complete finite multiset/run decomposition and direct disjoint-case enumeration; reproducibility via standard-library standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: An exact rank polynomial of self-inverse wheel partial isometries, not an enumeration of all elements or commuting pairs; independent finite checks for 3<=n<=9 do not replace the proof; possible unindexed equivalent results remain a literature risk.
title: Complete self-inverse rank enumerator for finite wheel partial-isometry monoids
